name: How long does a typical roof replacement assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof replacement assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical roof replacement assessment usually takes about 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the size and complexity of your roof. During this time, our technicians will thoroughly inspect all components of your roofing system, including shingles, flashing, gutters, and the attic interior if accessible, to identify all areas of concern.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessments typically last 30-60 minutes. Technicians inspect shingles, flashing, gutters, and the attic.
